name: Financial Model QA
description: Audit a financial model for formula integrity, assumptions, units, linkages, scenario behavior, reconciliation, and transparent outputs without turning QA into investment advice.

tasks.name: Map model architecture
tasks.objective: Identify inputs, calculations, schedules, statements, outputs, scenarios, external links, macros or scripts, named ranges, currencies, units, periods, and intended decisions.

tasks.name: Audit inputs and assumptions
tasks.objective: Trace material inputs to sources, dates, units, sign conventions, inflation/FX treatment, growth or pricing assumptions, tax/rate assumptions, scenario selectors, and undocumented hardcodes.

tasks.name: Audit formulas and linkages
tasks.objective: Check copied formulas, ranges, absolute/relative references, signs, period alignment, circular references, broken links, hidden rows/columns, aggregation, opening/closing balances, and formula consistency.

tasks.name: Run reconciliations and integrity tests
tasks.objective: Test balance-sheet balance where applicable, cash roll-forwards, debt/interest links, retained earnings, working capital, subtotal ties, unit conversions, historical-to-forecast transitions, and independent checksum controls.

tasks.name: Stress scenarios and sensitivities
tasks.objective: Change key assumptions systematically, test switches and boundaries, identify discontinuities or implausible outputs, and verify scenario isolation. Do not interpret QA results as an investment recommendation.

tasks.name: Publish model QA report
tasks.objective: Document defects with cell/range references, severity, effect on outputs, corrected logic or question, unresolved assumptions, test cases, version/hash, and a clean-versus-reviewed copy protocol.
